structured.approach: Attempt 3 rewrites feat.classification.md in full so that every statement rests only on feat.intake, feat.prebacklog, record:brief or record:memory. I removed all content that came from outside the contract: the related requirement IDs and what they say, the contents of the feature routing override, and the mention of the out-of-context search. I replaced the 'no write access to a ticketing system' statement with the cited fact that the only approved connector is GET-only api:github, and moved the question of who creates the ticket to OQ-C4. Routing now rests on the repository roles bound in the brief (DE, DS, BE, FE) together with the areas named in the intake. The duplicate check states what the inputs support: no duplicate is named, so nothing is merged, and the Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board check is still open (OQ-2 in feat.prebacklog). The classification is unchanged: the whole entry and each change request are classified against the workbook's Technical Only rule.

claims.text: The entry is classified as a business feature and is not Technical Only, because it lets AP managers see which overdue invoices belong to vendors that usually pay late. It is linked to roadmap item R-AP-12.

CR-1 (optional paid_date feed column), CR-2 (delays_by_vendor), CR-4 (optional risk argument on build_explanation_request) and CR-7 (end-to-end proof) are Technical Only sub-items. CR-3 (vendor_risk), CR-5 (overdue_with_risk) and CR-6 (renderOverdueRisk) carry the business outcome.

Impacted repositories: ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging, ap_portal. ap_pipeline is data engineering (DE), ap_forecast is AI / data science (DS), ap_aging is backend (BE) and ap_portal is frontend (FE).

No duplicates were merged. The intake and pre-backlog entry describe one ticket and name no other item for the same change. The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not in the inputs, a gap already raised as OQ-2.
No regulatory source applies, and no conflict was found with D-2026-031, D-2026-044 or D-2026-050.
The only connector approved for this step is api:github for GET calls, so the classification file holds the content of the new ticket.

open_questions: OQ-C1: Is there an approved category taxonomy for the Pre Backlog sheet? 'Business feature (customer-facing enhancement)' with a Technical sub-category per area is proposed.
OQ-C2: Please add the routing map to this step's contract inputs, and confirm the routing of each repository to its area agent and of the end-to-end flow (CR-7) to testing.
OQ-C3: Please provide the Pre Backlog sheet, the DevOps board and the other open requirement items as inputs, so that related or duplicate items can be checked and merged.
OQ-C4: Who creates the new ticket from feat.classification, and in which system? The approved connector for this step is GET-only api:github.
OQ-C5: Please confirm the Technical Only split: CR-1, CR-2, CR-4 and CR-7 are Technical Only, and the entry as a whole is not.
structured.summary: Attempt 3 rewrites feat.classification for FEAT-ZD-48600 and grounds every statement in the contract inputs and the brief. The entry is a business feature for AP managers, linked to R-AP-12, and as a whole it is not Technical Only. CR-1, CR-2, CR-4 and CR-7 are Technical Only sub-items, and CR-3, CR-5 and CR-6 carry the business outcome. Impacted repositories are ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging and ap_portal. No duplicates were merged. The full duplicate check, the routing-map input and ticket creation are raised as non-blocking open questions.
